hidden_assets.purpose: Gold migration energies and dimensionality for nine cation-ordered SrLaTiAlO6 structures
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper Table 2. Values: AC/BC 2.1 eV 2D; AC/BL 1.3 eV 1D; AC/BR 1.0 eV 1D; AL/BC 2.7 eV 2D; AL/BL 0.8 eV 2D; AL/BR 1.3 eV 2D; AR/BC 2.2 eV 1D; AR/BL 0.6 eV 2D; AR/BR 1.3 eV 3D.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly transcribed from the published article. Dimensionality labels match the paper's notation.

outputs.description: One row per cation ordering, containing the computed migration energy (float, eV) and dimensionality string ('1D','2D','3D'). Exact string match for ordering label and dimensionality; migration energy compared within a hidden tolerance of ±0.1 eV.

output_contract.notes: The checker validates that exactly nine rows are present and that each row matches the expected values within the defined tolerances. Rows may appear in any order.

steps.description: Validate migration energies and dimensionality for all nine ordered structures against paper gold values.
